notable_absence.finding: No management-plane role gate; sequence DDL uses the same pure credential-type/privilege-pair model as scope and function DDL in this batch.

cross_product_finding: Sequences (a counter/generator construct, evidence: 'A sequence is a construct that returns a sequence of integer values, one at a time, rather like a counter') get their own dedicated Advanced privilege name ('Query Manage Sequences') distinct from the generic 'Query Manage' seen on dropfunction.json, reinforcing that the Advanced axis mints one named privilege per DDL object kind, while Basic always stays at coarse Write/Read.
